description: This file defines Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) related to recipe operations in a backend service, including request, response, and search query representations.

classes.name: RecipeDtos
classes.description: A container class for various recipe-related DTO records, including RecipeRequest, RecipeResponse, and RecipeSearchQuery.

classes.name: RecipeDtos.RecipeRequest
classes.description: A record representing the data required to create or update a recipe, with validation annotations.

classes.name: RecipeDtos.RecipeResponse
classes.description: A record representing the data sent in response to recipe queries, including detailed recipe info.

classes.name: RecipeDtos.RecipeSearchQuery
classes.description: A record representing parameters for searching/filtering recipes.
